item.title: Dazzle Camouflage Is an Engineered Illusion, But Does It Work?
item.description: We think of camouflage as what animals use to blend in with their background. A ship that has zebra stripes that aren't even straight is not what a normal person would call camouflage. But a still photo doesn't do it justice, because ships are always in motion, and the enemy is looking for a ship in motion. If a ship sits still, it's probably not in a battle zone. item.title: The Colorful Confusion Caused By Kidney Wood
item.description: When Spain conquered Mexico, it opened up trade in all sorts of previously unknown products from the New World. One was Lignum nephriticum, a type of wood that, when soaked in water, would produce a tincture useful for treating kidney and urinary ailments. Lignum nephriticum literally means kidney wood. item.title: What Happened to the <i>Mona Lisa's</i> Eyebrows
item.description: Leonardo da Vinci's masterpiece known as the Mona Lisa is the world's most famous painting. As such, you might be surprised to find out it's a rather small portrait, and so many people go to the Louvre to see it that you can't really get close enough to study it. item.title: The Cosmic Odometer Calculates Your Personal Mileage
item.description: You may consider yourself a pretty sedentary person, maybe even a couch potato. But even so, you are constantly traveling through space. You travel thousands of miles every day as the earth rotates (24,000 if you live at the equator, less towards the poles). You are also traveling with earth around the sun. And the sun is moving, too. How far have we come?As they say, there's an app for that. The Cosmic Odometer will calculate how far you've traveled through space by your date and time of birth.

item.title: The Ghosts Who Haunt The Comedy Store
item.description: The Comedy Store in Los Angeles opened in 1972 and soon became a mecca for those hoping to break into the big time in standup comedy. The nightclub became famous for incubating the careers of some of the biggest comedians of the last 50 years. Of course, there have been plenty of comedians who graced the stage at The Comedy Store or else waited tables and never made it big. item.title: How Humans Built an Extraordinary Bond with Dogs
item.description: Nearly all domestic dogs are descended from the Eurasian gray wolf (Canis lupus). They first became pets long before we domesticated farm animals or developed agriculture or the written word, so we don't know where or when it happened. However, it only makes sense that the wolves who were the least fearful of humans got close enough to eat our leftovers.
